bit_field.name: REVISION
bit_field.description: Revision Number of the Controller Core

bit_field.name: PHYW
bit_field.description: Data width of the transceiver connected to the controller core

bit_field_value.name: HWGENERAL_PHYW_SW_RST_8
bit_field_value.description: Reset to 8 bit wide data bus (Software programmable)

bit_field_value.name: HWGENERAL_PHYW_SW_RST_16
bit_field_value.description: Reset to 16 bit wide data bus (Software programmable)

bit_field_value.name: HWGENERAL_PHYM_SW_RST_ULPI_DDR
bit_field_value.description: Software programmable - reset to ULPI DDR

bit_field_value.name: HWGENERAL_SM_SERIAL_ENGINE_NO
bit_field_value.description: No Serial Engine, always use parallel signalling

bit_field_value.name: HWGENERAL_SM_SERIAL_ENGINE_EN
bit_field_value.description: Serial Engine present, always use serial signalling for FS/LS

bit_field_value.name: HWGENERAL_SM_SW_RST_PARALLEL
bit_field_value.description: Software programmable - Reset to use parallel signalling for FS/LS

bit_field_value.name: HWGENERAL_SM_SW_RST_SERIAL_ENG
bit_field_value.description: Software programmable - Reset to use serial signalling for FS/LS

bit_field.name: NPORT
bit_field.description: The Number of downstream ports supported by the host controller is (NPORT+1)

bit_field.name: TXBURST
bit_field.description: Default burst size for memory to TX buffer transfer

bit_field.name: TXCHANADD
bit_field.description: TX FIFO Buffer size is: (2^TXCHANADD) * 4 Bytes

bit_field.name: RXBURST
bit_field.description: Default burst size for memory to RX buffer transfer

bit_field.name: RXADD
bit_field.description: Buffer total size for all receive endpoints is (2^RXADD)

bit_field_value.name: GPTIMER0CTRL_GPTRST_LOAD_CNTR
bit_field_value.description: Load counter value from GPTLD bits in n_GPTIMER0LD

bit_field_value.name: GPTIMER1CTRL_GPTRST_LOAD_CNTR
bit_field_value.description: Load counter value from GPTLD bits in USB_n_GPTIMER0LD

bit_field_value.name: SBUSCFG_AHBBRST_INCR_BURST
bit_field_value.description: Incremental burst of unspecified length only

bit_field_value.name: SBUSCFG_AHBBRST_INCR8_BURST
bit_field_value.description: INCR8 burst, INCR4 burst, then single transfer

bit_field_value.name: SBUSCFG_AHBBRST_INCR16_BURST
bit_field_value.description: INCR16 burst, INCR8 burst, INCR4 burst, then single transfer

bit_field_value.name: SBUSCFG_AHBBRST_INCR4_UNSPEC
bit_field_value.description: INCR4 burst, then incremental burst of unspecified length

bit_field_value.name: SBUSCFG_AHBBRST_INCR8_4_UNSPEC
bit_field_value.description: INCR8 burst, INCR4 burst, then incremental burst of unspecified length

bit_field_value.name: SBUSCFG_AHBBRST_INCR16_8_4_UNSPEC
bit_field_value.description: INCR16 burst, INCR8 burst, INCR4 burst, then incremental burst of unspecified length

bit_field.name: CAPLENGTH
bit_field.description: These bits are used as an offset to add to register base to find the beginning of the Operational Register. Default value is '40h'.

bit_field.name: N_PCC
bit_field.description: Number of Ports per Companion Controller

bit_field_value.name: HCSPARAMS_N_CC_NO_COMP_CONTROLLER
bit_field_value.description: There is no internal Companion Controller and port-ownership hand-off is not supported

bit_field_value.name: HCSPARAMS_N_CC_COMP_CONTROLLER
bit_field_value.description: There are internal companion controller(s) and port-ownership hand-offs is supported

bit_field.name: N_PTT
bit_field.description: Number of Ports per Transaction Translator

bit_field_value.name: USBCMD_PSE_DONT_PROCESS_PT
bit_field_value.description: Do not process the Periodic Schedule

bit_field_value.name: USBCMD_PSE_PROCESS_PT_PERIODICLISTBASE
bit_field_value.description: Use the PERIODICLISTBASE register to access the Periodic Schedule

bit_field_value.name: USBCMD_ASE_DONT_PROCESS_ASYNC
bit_field_value.description: Do not process the Asynchronous Schedule

bit_field_value.name: USBCMD_ASE_ACCESS_ASYNC
bit_field_value.description: Use the ASYNCLISTADDR register to access the Asynchronous Schedule

bit_field_value.name: CONFIGFLAG_CF_PORT_ROUTING_CLASSIC_HOST
bit_field_value.description: Port routing control logic default-routes each port to an implementation dependent classic host controller

bit_field_value.name: CONFIGFLAG_CF_PORT_ROUTING_HOST
bit_field_value.description: Port routing control logic default-routes all ports to this host controller

bit_field_value.name: PORTSC1_CCS_DISABLE
bit_field_value.description: In Host mode: No device is present. In Device mode: Not attached

bit_field_value.name: PORTSC1_CCS_ENABLE
bit_field_value.description: In Host mode: Device is present on port. In Device mode: Attached

bit_field_value.name: PORTSC1_OCA_NO_OVERCURRENT
bit_field_value.description: This port does not have an over-current condition

bit_field_value.name: PORTSC1_OCA_OVERCURRENT
bit_field_value.description: This port currently has an over-current condition

bit_field.name: PHCD
bit_field.description: PHY Low Power Suspend - Clock Disable (PLPSCD)

bit_field_value.name: USBMODE_CM_DEVICE_CONTR
bit_field_value.description: Device Controller [Default for device only controller]

bit_field_value.name: USBMODE_CM_HOST_CONTR
bit_field_value.description: Host Controller [Default for host only controller]
